从露头、遥感和化探样点寻找线索，再用地下资料交叉验证。地表特征不能唯一确定地下储: Outcrops, remote sensing and geochemical samples provide clues that require subsurface cross-checks. Surface features alone do not uniquely determine a reservoir.
震源激发弹性波，检波器记录传播与反射信号，用于解释地下界面与构造，并非直接拍摄地: A source generates elastic waves. Receivers record their propagation and reflections to interpret subsurface interfaces and structures rather than photograph the underground.
钻头穿过不同岩层，井眼把地表与目标层连接。轨迹与参数需要结合地质、工程和井下观测: The bit crosses rock formations to connect the surface with a target. Well trajectories and operating parameters depend on geology, engineering and downhole observations.
岩屑、气测与钻时提供随钻返回的地层线索；录井与测井的数据来源和观测方式不同。: Cuttings, mud gas and drilling-time records provide formation clues during drilling. Mud logging and wireline logging use different data sources and measurements.
测量工具沿井筒记录岩层物理响应，再结合岩心等资料解释岩性、层界与储层参数。: Tools record physical formation responses along a well. Core and other evidence support interpretations of lithology, boundaries and reservoir properties.
水泥浆置于套管与地层之间的环空，形成支撑与层间封隔；示意中的环带不是储层本身。: Cement is placed in the annulus between casing and formation to support the casing and isolate zones. The illustrated rings are not the reservoir.
完井按井况配置管柱与井下工具，为后续生产建立受控通道；具体方式取决于储层与工程条: Completion installs the tubing and downhole equipment needed for controlled production. The design depends on reservoir and engineering conditions.
套管井射孔穿过套管、水泥环及近井地层形成孔道，沟通井筒与储层。不是把整层岩石炸开: Cased-hole perforations create channels through casing, cement and the near-well formation to connect the well to the reservoir. They do not blast apart an entire rock layer.
储层流体经井筒到达地表。抽油机示意有杆泵举升的一种方式，不代表所有油井都需要抽油: Reservoir fluids reach the surface through the well. The pumpjack illustrates one form of rod pumping; not every oil well needs a pumpjack.
修井针对井筒、管柱或设备问题进行维护和处理，依据井史与诊断决定方案。: Workovers address problems with the wellbore, tubing or equipment. Well history and diagnostic evidence guide the intervention.
增采涉及注入、压裂及其他改善开发效果的措施；图中的注入线仅用于解释井与储层的联系: Recovery improvement includes injection, stimulation and other measures. The injection line illustrates the connection between a well and its reservoir.
井口产物经集输和处理后进入输送系统，压力、流量与完整性监测共同支撑运行。: Well fluids pass through gathering and treatment before transportation. Pressure, flow and integrity monitoring support operations.
炼化装置对原料进行分离、转化与质量控制。塔器只是流程中的一类设备，不能等同完整炼: Refining separates and converts feedstocks while controlling product quality. Towers are only one type of process equipment, not an entire refinery.
